links.outcome: Whether LLM judgments' certainty and specificity exceed what limited mental-health evidence supports
links.effect: Across 20 LLMs, a 'restraint gap' was found: the specificity or certainty of model judgments exceeds what limited evidence supports. No numbers are given in the abstract.
links.quote: Evaluating 20 LLMs reveals a restraint gap, in which the specificity or certainty of model judgments exceeds what limited evidence supports.

unlisted_practices: Post-training an LLM with hard-case supervision, structured reasoning-trajectory rewriting, and consistency-aware optimization to improve evidence-constrained mental-health reasoning
Evaluating the quality of explicit reasoning trajectories (usability, logical structure, informational contribution) in addition to final-answer accuracy

screen.reason: The study develops a benchmark (MiraMind) and trains a fine-tuned model (Mindora) to evaluate and improve LLM reasoning in mental health tasks, but it evaluates model capabilities rather than testing organizational deployment practices or safeguards.
